categories.main_business_segments: SITC International Holdings Company Limited operates primarily in two segments: container shipping and logistics, and dry bulk and others. The container shipping and logistics segment includes integrated logistics services such as container transportation, freight forwarding, shipping agency, depot, and warehousing. The dry bulk and others segment mainly involves dry bulk vessel leasing and land leasing services, though the company disposed of all dry bulk vessels in 2022 to focus on container shipping.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes a fleet of container vessels, including self-owned and chartered vessels, with an average age of 9.7 years. It employs integrated sea-land logistics solutions, including container slot exchange arrangements and joint services to optimize shipping routes. The company also invests in information technology systems to improve operational efficiency and supports multimodal transportation services. Environmental technologies are adopted to comply with regulations and reduce emissions, including the use of LNG-powered vessels.
categories.primary_customers_markets: SITC serves customers involved in intra-Asia trade, focusing on blue-chip companies requiring container shipping and integrated logistics services. Its services cater to industries reliant on containerized cargo movement across Asia, including freight forwarding and shipping agency clients. The company’s major markets include Mainland China, Japan, Korea, Taiwan, Hong Kong, Vietnam, Thailand, the Philippines, Cambodia, Indonesia, Singapore, Malaysia, Brunei, Bengal, Myanmar, Russia, and India.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates exclusively in the Asia trade market, covering 76 major ports and cities across Greater China (Mainland China, Hong Kong, Taiwan), Southeast Asia, Japan, Korea, and other Asian countries. It maintains a dense shipping logistics network with 75 trade lanes, including joint services and container slot exchange arrangements. The company also operates depots and warehousing facilities in key Asian locations such as China, Malaysia, Indonesia, Thailand, and Vietnam.
categories.supply_chain_position: SITC operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the shipping logistics supply chain. It owns and charters container vessels for transportation (midstream) and provides integrated logistics services including freight forwarding, shipping agency, depot, and warehousing (downstream). The company also leases land and vessels, positioning itself as a comprehensive logistics service provider within the intra-Asia trade supply chain.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on optimizing its unique operation model, expanding its intra-Asia service network, increasing voyage frequency, and extending the sea-land integrated service value chain. It prioritizes fleet structure optimization by leveraging vessel price and rent dynamics to maintain cost competitiveness and reduce hazardous gas emissions. Operational efficiency improvements through enhanced organizational processes and information technology systems are key R&D directions, aiming to become a world-class integrated logistics service provider.
categories.revenue_model: SITC generates revenue primarily through container shipping and supporting logistics services, including container transportation, freight forwarding, shipping agency, depot, and warehousing. Revenue is recognized over time as services are rendered, with additional income from vessel leasing and land leasing in the dry bulk and others segment. The company also earns income from rental of land and buildings under operating leases and gains from disposal of vessels.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: SITC is ranked 13th among international container shipping companies by shipping capacity and is a leading player in the intra-Asia shipping logistics market. It competes with other container shipping and logistics providers focusing on Asia trade lanes. The company differentiates itself through a high-density, high-frequency container shipping route network and integrated logistics services, maintaining a stable and growing market share despite industry challenges.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the year ended 31 December 2022, SITC reported a turnover of approximately US$4.11 billion, a 36.5% increase from 2021, and a profit attributable to shareholders of approximately US$1.94 billion, a 67.2% increase. The company operated 108 container vessels with a total capacity of 162,701 TEUs, including 84 self-owned vessels. It has shown consistent growth in container shipping volume and freight rates, with strong cash flows and a net cash position (zero gearing ratio).
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: SITC emphasizes its comprehensive intra-Asia shipping logistics network, high-frequency and high-density container shipping routes, and integrated sea-land logistics solutions. The company leverages its unique business model, fleet optimization, and advanced information management to provide efficient, cost-competitive, and tailored logistics services. Its commitment to environmental compliance and innovation, including LNG-powered vessels and sustainable practices, further differentiates its value proposition.
